claims.disproof_condition: Raise substitutability if patent enforcement or licensing disclosures show GBD legally concentrated (e.g., litigation forcing Chinese makers to license or exit); lower further if additional makers disclose scaled GBD output. Patent-licensing structure is unverified in this RA — tracked separately.
claims.statement: JL MAG mass-produces and sells grain-boundary-diffusion NdFeB magnets at scale in China (2022: GBD product production and sales volume increased significantly, historical highs, leading position in NEV/VFAC/wind segments — self-reported HKEX filing). Together with Proterial's mass-production of heavy-rare-earth-saving material in Japan, GBD is a diffused production technology among top-tier magnet makers on both sides, NOT a single-company bottleneck; substitutability of any one GBD producer judged 2/5. The scarce layer remains upstream separated heavy REO (Dy/Tb) feedstock, not the diffusion process itself.
